svg.title: Timing identity and histogram estimation have different scope
svg.desc: Separate generator-stall and expected-interval compensation fixtures
svg.text: Timing identity and histogram estimation have different scope
Separate generator-stall and expected-interval compensation fixtures
Name compatible client events
s intended; d actual dispatch; z terminal
Lag = d−s; actual interval = z−d
Planned-demand interval z−s = their sum
Five-request generator stall reference
Mean lag 9 ms; post-dispatch 3.4 ms
Mean planned-demand interval 12.4 ms
Catch-up at 35 ms creates server queueing
One observed 100-ms sample; interval 10
Estimated series 100,90,…,10 ms
One observed + nine estimated; mean 55 ms
Actual ten-job reference mean is 59.5 ms
Estimates cannot create service evidence
Keep raw, planned and estimated separate
No estimated successes, tokens or byte counts
No double correction of the same omission
Bound backlog and client resources; record skip/stop/throttle and every unresolved outcome.
Keep generator lag distinct from server processing and from uncorrelated network timing.
